mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(totalAmount), 0) AS todayAmount, COUNT(*) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus = 'PENDING' OR orderStatus = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus = 'COOKING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processingOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM( (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM orderItem oi WHERE oi.orderId = o.id) ), 0) AS todayDishCount FROM orders o WHERE DATE(orderedAt) = CURDATE() AND orderStatus <> 'CANCELLED'

SELECT o.orderNumber, o.totalAmount, o.orderStatus, o.orderedAt, t.tableNumber, u.nickname FROM orders o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.userId LEFT JOIN diningTable t ON t.id = o.tableId ORDER BY o.orderedAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, dishName, price, saleNumber, coverImage FROM dish WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY saleNumber DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(orderedAt) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(totalAmount), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE orderedAt >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND orderStatus <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY DATE(orderedAt) ORDER BY day
SELECT tableStatus, COUNT(*) AS tableCount FROM diningTable GROUP BY tableStatus
